tables.name: DailyAudience
tables.grain: one row per campaign per date; unique_visitors is daily snapshot

tables.name: CampaignTags
tables.grain: one row per tag; many tags may belong to one campaign

measures.name: unique_visitors
measures.basis: CampaignTags may repeat campaign rows, and summing daily unique-visitor snapshots across seven dates is non-additive. No tag deduplication or cross-date uniqueness rule is supplied.

sequence: Join DailyAudience to CampaignTags on campaign_id.
risks: Multiple priority tags can duplicate daily audience rows.
Daily unique visitors cannot be summed into weekly unique visitors without a supplied cross-date rule.
alternatives: Conditional: use a distinct qualifying campaign_id set or semi-join after confirming tag-existence semantics.
A weekly unique-visitor method requires an explicit cross-date identity or aggregation rule; none is supplied.
